name: Touhou Gensokyo Visitor
source:
Walking through the forest, Reimu meets a stranger in the forest, now she needs to understand where he came from, and how he got through the barrier.
This is a short story about what difficulties await a person who got into Gensokyo.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
穿过森林，灵梦在森林中遇到了一个陌生人，现在她需要了解他来自哪里，以及他是如何穿过结界的。
这是一个关于进入幻想乡的人将面临怎样的困难的短篇故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350350/]Steam[/url]]
